limitations: Only binary de Bruijn cycles of order five and the specified cut-optimized aperiodic autocorrelation maximum are classified; larger orders, other normalizations, and practical channel-performance conclusions are outside scope. Equivalent undiscovered literature remains possible.
scientific_integrity: The exact finite histogram is certified by exhaustive enumerations of the 2048 cyclic sequences with independent generation and evaluation methods, not by an asymptotic extrapolation. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
title: Exact optimal-cut aperiodic peak-sidelobe spectrum of binary order-five de Bruijn cycles
